rationale: Shreyas brings hands-on supply chain analytics experience from Saint Gobain and a track record managing operations across hospitality and project management, while Joyce is building AI tools specifically designed to unlock efficiency in manufacturing and supply chain operations. Joyce's conviction that frontline workers need accessible AI aligns directly with Shreyas's data-driven operations background and explicit interest in operational improvement, making this a natural conversation about how AI can be applied to the real supply chain challenges Shreyas knows.
intro_message: Shreyas Khatav, meet Joyce G — she's building an AI platform for manufacturing and supply chain operations, and your hands-on experience optimizing supply chain analytics at Saint Gobain could be valuable as she thinks through how to serve operations teams.
